“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

He was equally eager to become the ultimate.

To begin with, only by stepping into that level could one truly have self-preservation power. As for now? Relying on the power of human civilization was also enough to ensure self-preservation.

But between relying on external power and one’s own abilities, Lin Yuan preferred the latter.

...

“After stepping into the Tenth Rank, your inner world will establish a connection with the Origin Source of the universe and will naturally and slowly evolve.”

“So what you need to do now is to enlighten as many Fusion Rules as possible and then integrate them into your inner world to enhance its foundation.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being spoke.

“Enlighten more Fusion Rules…”

Lin Yuan suddenly understood.

The more Fusion Rules a Tenth Rank strong one enlightens, the stronger their power is assumed to be.

In theory, even among Grade A Tier 10s, there is a clear distinction in strength.

A Grade A Tier 10 who has enlightened one Pillar-level Fusion Rule is clearly weaker than a Grade A Tier 10 who has enlightened two.

Moreover, distinguishing between someone who has created a new rule after fusing three Pillar Rules and another who did so with only two is also quite easy.

Even involving the Rule of Time with basic rules in fusion can significantly enhance the methods available to a Grade A Tier 10.

The Rule of Time, even when merged with an ordinary rule, can produce might far surpassing that of a new rule formed by the fusion of two Pillar Rules.

“Right.”

“Actually, even at Tier 11, it’s mainly about fusing more rules.”

“However, an Eleventh-Rank Life fuses the Rule of Time with the Space Rules. If possible, the more Pillar Rules fused, the greater the benefits.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being nodded.

“Chaos Rules?” Lin Yuan couldn’t help asking.

“You actually know about Chaos Rules?” Xia Qin Supreme Being was astonished; human civilization couldn’t possibly know about Chaos Rules without that enormous opportunity falling from beyond the universe.

“I once obtained a little information about Chaos Rules at a place of opportunity within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm,” Lin Yuan said, half-truthfully.

The matter of Chaos Rules, indeed, was something he learned from within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Nevertheless, it wasn’t from a place of opportunity, but rather from the Spirit of the Mysterious Realm, the Six-Armed Silhouette, who spoke to him.

It came from that Xuanhuang Emperor, who had vanished for endless ages.

“The Xuanhuang Secret Realm was indeed left by an incredibly powerful being, so it’s normal that he had some information about the Chaos Rules,” Xia Qin Supreme Being didn’t think too much of it.

Extrapolating from the present to the past, Xia Qin Supreme Being was aware that Lin Yuan’s strength while he was in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was significantly reserved.

Under such circumstances, entering a place of opportunity that defies common sense and obtaining high-level information was nothing strange.

“An Eleventh-Rank Life would indeed greatly benefit from enlightening the Chaos Rules when challenging the ultimate,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said with a hint of sentiment, “but don’t pursue this matter too much. For an Eleventh-Rank Life to enlighten Chaos Rules is almost impossible.”

“So that’s how it is,” Lin Yuan inwardly exclaimed.

The disturbance he caused during his breakthrough had already confirmed his innate potential.

Even so, Xia Qin Supreme Being still didn’t believe Lin Yuan could enlighten the Chaos Rules, obviously indicating the extreme difficulty of the task.

…

“By the way,”

“Announcing the advancement to Tenth Rank can wait a few more years,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said, “The commotion caused by your breakthrough was immense. Those Alien Strong Ones from the outside world believe that our human civilization has given birth to an Eleventh-Rank Evolver who has thoroughly understood the Rule of Time.”

“So, I plan to go with the flow and first announce that a reclusive Evolver of human civilization has comprehended the Rule of Time, and then has broken through to Tier 11 in the Central Star Domain.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan.

Comprehending the Rule of Time at Tenth Rank, although inconceivable, there were precedents after all.

The reactions of those Alien Strong Ones wouldn’t be too severe.

But comprehending the Rule of Time at Ninth Rank? And causing such a big disturbance during the breakthrough?

Those Alien Strong Ones would probably become restive, seeking all means to target Lin Yuan.

While the human Supreme Beings would pay more attention to Lin Yuan and not let those Alien Strong Ones succeed,

It was still better to avoid such incidents if possible.

“Can it really be concealed?” Lin Yuan was quite curious.

“If I hadn’t witnessed it with my own eyes, I wouldn’t have believed that a breakthrough from Ninth to Tenth Rank could cause such a grand disturbance,” Xia Qin Supreme Being glanced at Lin Yuan.

The look the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being beside him cast towards Lin Yuan also flashed with astonishment.

Compared to the ‘illusion’ that human civilization is about to present to other species, the true truth is even more unbelievable, isn’t it?

“Alright.”

“Now that you’ve stepped into Tenth Rank, I should be going back,”

“Familiarize yourself well with the power after Tenth Rank,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said, then vanished from view.

Even a normal breakthrough from Ninth to Tenth Rank would lead to an infusion from the universe’s Origin Source.

Everything about oneself would be significantly improved, so the most important thing for a newcomer to Tenth Rank is to adapt to the surge in power.

Lin Yuan’s induction was beyond a hundred times that of the Origin Source of the universe from the Chaos Void Origin, and the amount was unfathomable. The magnitude of his strength’s increase was also well beyond what is normal for a Ninth to Tenth Rank ascension by tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of times.

Feather Butterfly Supreme Being glanced at Lin Yuan one last time before she, too, disappeared without a trace.

Upon seeing this, Lin Yuan turned and returned to the Milky Way Main Star.

Because the Supreme Beings intervened to isolate space-time, none of the Evolvers in the Milky Way Star Region noticed,

Not even the Eighth Layer administrators on the Galactic Star knew—

That their Star Lord had become a Tenth Rank Evolver.

Whoosh.

Inside the Star Lord’s Great Hall.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared.

He then sat down cross-legged.

Having broken through to Tenth Rank, Lin Yuan went to see Xia Qin Supreme Being and Feather Butterfly Supreme Being immediately, not even having the chance to carefully compare his own changes in strength. Now was a good time to slowly feel them out.
